patch_description:
This version improves placement quality using deterministic multi-start greedy packing and lexicographic KVPR balancing.

It tries several complementary model orderings, including pressure-first, size-first, pressure-per-remaining-memory, pressure density, and size/pressure tradeoffs. For each ordering, models are placed on the GPU producing the best sorted KVPR vector, rather than only minimizing one GPU’s immediate pressure.

The best seeds are then refined with relocation and swap local search. Local search accepts lexicographic improvements to the complete sorted KVPR vector, so it can improve secondary GPU pressures even when the maximum KVPR is unchanged, enabling later improvements that simple maximum-only local search misses. All moves and swaps preserve GPU memory feasibility.
